title: Build logistics navigation and overview UI
goal: Ship the five-tab logistics shell, canonical scope behavior, legacy URL compatibility, and single-request overview command center.

evidence: Logistics now renders five visible primary tabs, independent tour/event selection, canonical URL aliases, and one overview data hook.

progress.summary: Five-tab scope shell and portfolio Overview UI implemented with legacy URL compatibility and no implicit tour selection.
completed: Overview, Travel & Transport, Production, Comms, and Maps are directly visible.
Standalone events can be selected and organization mismatches clear dependent scope.
Overview uses one aggregate Logistics request after acting context is ready.
next_steps: Complete authenticated Back/Forward and refresh regression under QA-007.
